plaintext: THE MORNING STAR RISES IN THE EAST

title: beaufort — Intermediate
plaintext: THE WATCHMAN STANDS AT HIS POST

title: beaufort — Intermediate
plaintext: THE HARVEST IS PLENTIFUL BUT THE WORKERS FEW

title: beaufort — Intermediate
plaintext: FAITH IS THE SUBSTANCE OF THINGS HOPED FOR THE EVIDENCE OF THINGS NOT SEEN

title: beaufort — Intermediate
plaintext: THE LORD WILL FIGHT FOR YOU AND YOU SHALL HOLD YOUR PEACE AND REST IN HIM

title: beaufort — Intermediate
plaintext: MY GRACE IS SUFFICIENT FOR YOU FOR MY STRENGTH IS MADE PERFECT IN YOUR WEAKNESS ALONE

title: beaufort — Intermediate
plaintext: I AM THE WAY THE TRUTH AND THE LIFE NO MAN COMETH UNTO THE FATHER BUT THROUGH ME ALONE

title: beaufort — Intermediate
plaintext: THE LORD GIVES WISDOM FROM HIS MOUTH COME KNOWLEDGE AND UNDERSTANDING FOR ALL NATIONS

title: beaufort — Intermediate
plaintext: THE ENEMY SHALL NOT PASS THIS GATE FOR GOD AND COUNTRY WE STAND FIRM TOGETHER AS ONE

title: beaufort — Intermediate
plaintext: STAND FIRM AND DO NOT LET YOURSELVES BE BURDENED AGAIN BY A YOKE OF SLAVERY TO SIN

title: beaufort — Intermediate
plaintext: FOR WE ARE GOD IS HANDIWORK CREATED IN CHRIST JESUS TO DO GOOD WORKS PREPARED IN ADVANCE

title: beaufort — Intermediate
plaintext: THE RACE IS NOT TO THE SWIFT NOR THE BATTLE TO THE STRONG BUT TO THOSE WHO ENDURE

title: beaufort — Intermediate
plaintext: FROM THE RISING OF THE SUN TO ITS SETTING THE NAME OF THE LORD IS TO BE PRAISED ALWAYS

title: beaufort — Intermediate
plaintext: HE GIVES STRENGTH TO THE WEARY AND INCREASES THE POWER OF THE WEAK WHO TRUST IN HIM

title: beaufort — Intermediate
plaintext: COMMIT YOUR WORKS UNTO THE LORD AND YOUR THOUGHTS SHALL BE ESTABLISHED BY HIS GREAT HAND

title: beaufort — Intermediate
plaintext: THE SPIRIT OF THE LORD IS UPON ME BECAUSE HE HATH ANOINTED ME TO PREACH THE GOOD NEWS

title: beaufort — Intermediate
plaintext: LOVE IS PATIENT LOVE IS KIND IT DOES NOT ENVY IT DOES NOT BOAST IT IS NOT PROUD AT ALL

title: beaufort — Intermediate

title: gronsfeld — Intermediate
plaintext: FOR THE LORD YOUR GOD IS A CONSUMING FIRE A JEALOUS GOD WHO WILL NOT SHARE HIS GLORY WITH ANOTHER

title: gronsfeld — Intermediate
plaintext: THE NAME OF THE LORD IS A STRONG TOWER THE RIGHTEOUS RUN TO IT AND ARE SAFE FROM ALL THEIR ENEMIES

title: gronsfeld — Intermediate
plaintext: CALL TO ME AND I WILL ANSWER YOU AND TELL YOU GREAT AND UNSEARCHABLE THINGS THAT YOU DO NOT KNOW

title: gronsfeld — Intermediate
plaintext: LET US NOT BECOME WEARY IN DOING GOOD FOR AT THE PROPER TIME WE WILL REAP A HARVEST IF WE DO NOT GIVE UP

title: gronsfeld — Intermediate
plaintext: NOW TO HIM WHO IS ABLE TO DO IMMEASURABLY MORE THAN ALL WE ASK OR IMAGINE ACCORDING TO HIS POWER WITHIN US

title: gronsfeld — Intermediate
plaintext: FOR I AM CONVINCED THAT NEITHER DEATH NOR LIFE NEITHER ANGELS NOR DEMONS SHALL SEPARATE US FROM GODS LOVE

title: gronsfeld — Intermediate
plaintext: BUT THOSE WHO HOPE IN THE LORD WILL RENEW THEIR STRENGTH THEY WILL SOAR ON WINGS LIKE EAGLES AND NOT GROW TIRED

title: gronsfeld — Intermediate
plaintext: THE FIRST SHALL BE LAST AND THE LAST SHALL BE FIRST FOR THE KINGDOM BELONGS TO THE HUMBLE

title: gronsfeld — Intermediate
plaintext: BLESSED ARE THOSE WHO HUNGER AND THIRST FOR RIGHTEOUSNESS FOR THEY WILL BE FILLED WITH GOOD

title: gronsfeld — Intermediate
plaintext: THE SPIRIT IS WILLING BUT THE FLESH IS WEAK WE MUST WATCH AND PRAY WITHOUT CEASING AT ALL

title: gronsfeld — Intermediate
plaintext: FOR WHERE YOUR TREASURE IS THERE YOUR HEART WILL BE ALSO SO SEEK THE THINGS OF GOD ABOVE

title: gronsfeld — Intermediate
plaintext: WHOEVER FINDS HIS LIFE WILL LOSE IT AND WHOEVER LOSES HIS LIFE FOR MY SAKE WILL FIND IT

title: gronsfeld — Intermediate
plaintext: THE WEAPONS WE FIGHT WITH ARE NOT THE WEAPONS OF THE WORLD FOR GOD GIVES US STRENGTH

title: gronsfeld — Intermediate
plaintext: BE WATCHFUL STAND FIRM IN THE FAITH ACT LIKE MEN BE STRONG LET ALL THAT YOU DO BE DONE IN LOVE

title: gronsfeld — Intermediate
plaintext: THE PRAYER OF A RIGHTEOUS PERSON IS POWERFUL AND EFFECTIVE IN REACHING THE VERY THRONE OF GOD

title: gronsfeld — Intermediate
plaintext: IF GOD IS FOR US WHO CAN BE AGAINST US HE WHO DID NOT SPARE HIS OWN SON GAVE HIM FOR US ALL

title: gronsfeld — Intermediate
plaintext: THEREFORE DO NOT BE ANXIOUS ABOUT TOMORROW FOR TOMORROW WILL BE ANXIOUS FOR ITSELF TODAY IS ENOUGH
